subject: Dedicated sprint provisioning - ops check for VentusAI deal
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@ventusai.com>
Cc: procurement@ventusai.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated sprint provisioning - ops check for VentusAI deal

Hi team / Jordan,

Quick check as we move into final POC sign-off: VentusAI is asking to lock a dedicated sprint allocation for their Transformer fine-tuning workload. Ask from the customer:
- 8x high-memory GPU equivalents (A100-80GB class),
- sustained throughput target: ~120M tokens/day,
- initial duration: 12 weeks starting target week of Jun 3.

Can infra Ops confirm whether we have the capacity to:
1) Place a provisional soft-hold on 8 units from our US-dedicated pool for the Jun 3 start window, with the ability to convert to reserved capacity within 10 business days of signature;
2) Provide an inventory snapshot that maps which pools (pool-us-1, pool-us-2) / node ids would satisfy the requirement;
3) Recommend fallback SKUs (e.g., 4x L40s equivalent + batching changes) if A100-class is constrained.

Attached: ventus_mop_plan.pdf (customer MOP + expected ramp), gpu_inventory_snapshot.csv (current high-level inventory exported for context).

Jordan — please confirm that the 12-week duration and start-week are correct from your side, and whether procurement needs a formal soft-hold confirmation note to proceed with the PO.

Thanks,
Michael

--
Michael Grant
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mg@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0183
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated sprint provisioning - ops check for VentusAI deal

Thanks for the heads-up, Michael. Looping in Ops (Neha) to validate available runway. A couple of clarifying items from my side:
- Do we want to mark this as a "soft hold" (non-billable, release if not converted) or a "pre-commit" (billing trigger on signature)? Customer asked for convert-window of 10 business days, which sounds like soft hold with conversion-to-reserved on contract signing.
- Any SLA/latency SLO variations the team should be aware of for this sprint? If they expect <20ms p50 we may need different pod sizing.

Jordan — curious if Ventus has any constraint on node locality (single AZ) or if multi-AZ is fine.

-Ben

--
Ben Carter
Head of Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@ventusai.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated sprint provisioning - ops check for VentusAI deal

On Fri, May 17, 2029 at 09:12 AM Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Quick check as we move into final POC sign-off: VentusAI is asking to lock a dedicated sprint allocation for their Transformer fine-tuning workload...

Michael / Ben / Jordan — thanks for the details. Summary from Capacity: we can support the requested profile but with a couple of operational notes and a proposed play: 

Status & recommendations:
- Current US dedicated pools contain 11 A100-80GB-equivalent slots available between pool-us-1 (6 slots) and pool-us-2 (5 slots) in the Jun 1-15 window. I attached an internal snapshot export for traceability.
- We recommend placing a soft hold for 8 slots across pool-us-1 and pool-us-2 (3 + 5 mapping) to avoid fragmenting the run. This hold will be non-billable and auto-expire in 21 days unless converted to reserve.
- If customer needs single-AZ locality we can map all 8 to pool-us-2 but that means delaying start by ~5 business days for node reprovisioning; multi-AZ recommended for immediate start.
- Fallback: if A100-class becomes constrained, we propose a quantized path: 4x L40-class + aggressive batching + KV cache tuning; expected throughput impact ~-15% but preserves start date.

Next steps (Ops action items):
1) I'll open a formal provisional hold ticket (PH-789) and attach the inventory snapshot — Michael/Ben please confirm that soft-hold terms are acceptable to the customer.
2) If accepted, we’ll create a hold record and publish a brief sign-off note for procurement (DocuSign-ready) that confirms the conversion window and billing triggers.
3) Ops will publish the node mapping and ETA (we estimate 24-48 hrs to complete hold creation once approved).

Attachments: provisional_hold_ticket_789.pdf (internal ticket stub).

Laura — please file a quick note in the customer record and add the conversion-window language to the deal doc. Michael — Jordan, Ben — I’ll standby for your confirmation to lock the soft hold.

-Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Director, Capacity & Operations | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@ventusai.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@ventusai.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2029 14:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated sprint provisioning - ops check for VentusAI deal

Thanks, Michael and Neha — appreciate the quick turnaround. We are aligned with the ask and agree to the soft-hold model with a 10 business day conversion window. A couple of quick items from procurement: 

- Can you provide the provisional hold confirmation note (DocuSign-ready) that includes the conversion window, billing trigger (signature), and estimated start date (Jun 3)? Procurement needs that to approve the PO queue.
- Please confirm whether the soft hold will reserve specific node ids (recommended) or a slot count in the pools. We prefer explicit node ids for auditability.

If you can send the DocuSign-ready note and node mapping today, we can turn the PO within 48 hours.

Jordan
VP, Infrastructure — VentusAI
jordan.miles@ventusai.com
